value.rationale: Nontrivial complete shattering-complex classification of a natural 2-connected, three-arm noncactus graph family, giving every coefficient for all positive arm lengths. The fourth coefficient depends on 3 distinct topological support types rather than a numerical VC value alone; it provides a tractable separator-based test case beyond paths and cycles.
